execution_steps: 1. Confirmed UBL Line elements (InvoiceLine/CreditNoteLine/OrderLine) are always the trailing repeating group in every maindoc type's own real schema sequence -- meaning appending a new line after the last existing one (or at the end of the root's children when none exist) is schema-position-correct by construction, without needing root-level reordering support (_ORDER_CHECKED_COMPONENTS does not cover document root types, only nested complexTypes).

2. Designed add_line/remove_line/move_line/renumber_lines around business_role()/DocumentIndex (query.py) for line identification, _own_identifier for reading a line's own ID, and a shared _refuse_if_worse helper comparing before/after validate() diagnostic codes.

3. Verified all 4 operations end-to-end via a standalone repro before writing any test: add appends correctly and stays valid; move reorders among lines only; renumber_lines rewrites IDs and returns the exact old->new map applied; remove deletes the matching line only. Also verified all refusal paths (nonexistent ID, out-of-range move index, two lines mapped to the same new ID, a rename colliding with an unrenamed line's own existing ID).

4. Found a real gap in the first draft: add_line silently accepted a new line whose ID duplicated an EXISTING line's ID, because _refuse_if_worse only called the base validate() (chassis-only), which has no duplicate-line-id check -- that check lives in the referential layer built for validate_all() at FF6-EVENT-000296, a DIFFERENT function operating on raw sources rather than an already-loaded UblDocument. Fixed by inlining a local DocumentIndex(document.root).duplicate_line_ids()-based check into _refuse_if_worse directly (not by depending on combined.py's own private helper, to avoid an unusual reverse-layering dependency), then added a dedicated regression test naming the bug.

5. Ran mypy --strict (clean), ruff (clean), the full ubl suite (1044 passed at first pass, 1044 unchanged after the referential-check fix since it only added 1 more test), and the 6-format regression (3677 -> 3678 passed, +1 for the regression test, 0 failed).

6. Updated the ledger: SAL-UBL-OBL-AF5263F0FC7036B9 promoted missing->implemented (all 4 named operations exist, renumber_lines returns the explicit reference-rewrite map the rule_text names verbatim). SAL-UBL-OBL-237188D47391391E narrowed missing->partial, honestly documenting that 'core business components' is broader than lines -- parties, payment means, tax totals etc. remain uncovered by a dedicated CRUD API, a genuinely separate, larger undertaking since arbitrary-position insertion (unlike lines, always trailing) would need order knowledge extended to document root types.
